title: YAAMS
description: Domain, queue and security gauges exported by the YAAMS /metrics endpoint.

panels.title: Active users (24h)
panels.description: Users with an authenticated request in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Block hours
panels.description: Total block time of all accepted flights.

panels.title: Flights filed (rolling 24h)
panels.description: New PIREPs within a rolling 24h window (all review states).

panels.title: Block hours flown (rolling 24h)
panels.description: Accepted block time added within a rolling 24h window.

panels.title: Pending PIREPs
panels.description: Flights awaiting review by a Dispatcher/Manager.

panels.title: Pending screenshots
panels.description: Pilot-uploaded aircraft screenshots awaiting manager approval.

panels.title: Active users
panels.description: Users seen within each time window (based on the last authenticated request).

panels.title: 2FA adoption
panels.description: Share of users with confirmed two-factor authentication.

panels.title: Queue size
panels.description: Jobs waiting in the queue (mostly notification emails).

panels.title: Oldest pending job
panels.description: Age of the oldest pending job. Rising steadily means the queue worker is not running.

panels.title: Failed jobs
panels.description: Rows in failed_jobs. Inspect with `php artisan queue:failed`.

panels.title: Failed logins (24h)
panels.description: Failed login attempts recorded in the activity log within the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Activity log rows
panels.description: Size of the activity log; should plateau once activitylog:clean prunes daily.
